# Exercise No No

> [SITE DESCRIPTION — 1-2 sentences for the home page meta description]

Exercise No No (https://exercisenono.com) publishes free, illustrated exercise guides with start and finish positions, step-by-step instructions and common mistakes. Printable PDF versions (A4 and US Letter) are sold by The Shop Curator on Etsy. General information, not medical advice.
